statusMeaning.en: Status tracks deliverables, not investment validity. Done can mean a bounded diagnostic is complete; it does not certify PIT data, executable alpha or a successful hypothesis.
statusMeaning.zh: 状态表示交付进展，不表示投资有效性。完成可以只指一项有边界的诊断完成，不认证时点数据、可成交Alpha或假设成立。

title.zh: 固定保留来源与版本

acceptance.en: Record hashes, dates and the distinct 86/134/136-period samples.
acceptance.zh: 登记哈希、日期，区分86／134／136期样本。

nextAction.en: Preserve identities when new evidence is added.
nextAction.zh: 新增证据时继续保留原版本身份。

title.zh: 解释120日窗口复现差异

acceptance.en: Recover generating code/input/support rules and reconcile 7.60%, 4.22% and 6.26% without selecting a preferred result.
acceptance.zh: 恢复生成代码、输入与支持度规则，解释7.60%、4.22%、6.26%的差异，不挑选有利版本。

nextAction.en: Compare named replay receipts; separate recovered files from a recovered original run.
nextAction.zh: 核对具名重放收据，区分找到了文件与恢复了原始运行。

title.zh: 认证历史入选资格

acceptance.en: Each formation membership has dated source/version, ST, listing and trading-eligibility evidence.
acceptance.zh: 每个形成日名单有时点来源、版本、ST、上市及交易资格证据。

nextAction.en: Audit the historical membership release and keep unresolved classifications.
nextAction.zh: 审查历史名单资产，保留未解决的资格分类。

gap.en: Archived scores alone do not certify historical eligibility.
gap.zh: 仅凭归档评分不能认证历史入选资格。

title.zh: 核对价格与公司行动

acceptance.en: Raw/adjusted prices, shares and cash reconcile across splits, dividends and anomalous jumps.
acceptance.zh: 原始／复权价格、股数、现金能跨拆并股、分红与异常跳变核对。

nextAction.en: Prioritize unresolved 2008–2016 jumps and retain unmatched events.
nextAction.zh: 优先核对2008至2016年未解决跳变，保留无法匹配的事件。

title.zh: 固定缺价与退市处理

acceptance.en: Every selected holding remains in the ledger; unknown valuations are never silently zeroed or replaced.
acceptance.zh: 所有入选持仓留在账本，未知估值不静默置零或换股。

nextAction.en: Bind interval valuation and settlement policies to an auditable source release.
nextAction.zh: 将区间估值、结算政策绑定到可审计来源版本。

gap.en: Complete historical terminal valuations and interval coverage are not yet certified.
gap.zh: 完整历史终值与区间覆盖尚未认证。

title.zh: 明确共同交易时点契约

acceptance.en: Formation, earliest decision/execution, T+1 and valuation intervals are explicit for every comparison.
acceptance.zh: 所有比较明确形成、最早决策／执行、T+1及估值区间。

nextAction.en: Apply the written specification only after the data and ledger admission gates pass.
nextAction.zh: 数据及账本门槛通过后，再按已写规范实施。

title.zh: 构建三组共同支持的目标名单

acceptance.en: Use one outcome-free cohort/support for benchmark, high-turnover exclusion and low-turnover selection; audit weights and missingness.
acceptance.zh: 基准、高换手剔除与低换手选择共用不依赖未来结果的股票池／支持集，并核对权重及缺失。

nextAction.en: Pass retained targets and support exclusions into the ledger readiness review.
nextAction.zh: 将保留目标与支持集剔除记录交给账本就绪检查。

title.zh: 扩展共同份额与现金账本

acceptance.en: Reconcile positions, cash, fees, actions, failures and terminal valuation over the admitted history using the shared provider.
acceptance.zh: 使用共享提供方，在获准历史上核对仓位、现金、费用、公司行动、失败与终值。

nextAction.en: Reuse the existing ledger pilot; gate extension on timing and historical inputs.
nextAction.zh: 复用已有账本试点，按时点及历史输入门槛扩展。

title.en: Compare three matched net long-only accounts
title.zh: 比较三组配对多头净账户

acceptance.en: Same dates, eligibility, ledger, execution and cost policy; report both spread legs and benchmark-relative net results.
acceptance.zh: 相同日期、资格、账本、执行和成本政策，并列多空两腿及相对基准净结果。

nextAction.en: Run the benchmark, exclusion and low-turnover accounts only after ledger admission.
nextAction.zh: 账本获准后再运行基准、剔除与低换手账户。

gap.en: Targets exist; a certified matched full-history account does not.
gap.zh: 目标名单已生成，经过认证的全历史配对账户尚未完成。

title.zh: 版本化公开风格描述符契约

acceptance.en: Document lag, unit, sign, clipping, standardization universe and coverage for each descriptor.
acceptance.zh: 逐项登记滞后、单位、方向、缩尾、标准化股票池与覆盖。

nextAction.en: Separate archived proxies from newly reproducible size/beta/volatility/liquidity descriptors.
nextAction.zh: 区分归档代理与可重新生成的规模、贝塔、波动、流动性描述符。

title.zh: 恢复历史行业版本

acceptance.en: Formation-date industry assignments are traceable; unknown exposure remains visible.
acceptance.zh: 形成日行业归属可追溯，未知行业暴露保持可见。

nextAction.en: Audit industry revisions before using dummies in attribution.
nextAction.zh: 在归因使用行业变量前审计历史修订。

gap.en: Archived Top-50 industry unknown weight is material; a current classification cannot replace history.
gap.zh: 归档Top 50行业未知权重不可忽略，当前分类不能替代历史。

title.zh: 测量归档最终持仓暴露

acceptance.en: Compare raw/residual scores and K on common dates using broad and local benchmarks, preserving missing descriptors.
acceptance.zh: 共同日期比较原始／残差信号与K，保留广市场、局部基准及描述符缺失。

nextAction.en: Use the measured tail exposure reversal as a direct holding-level control requirement.
nextAction.zh: 将已测得的尾部暴露反向纳入持仓层检查要求。

title.zh: 核对已实现因子收益归因

acceptance.en: Lagged exposures, identified market/industry regression and account intervals reconcile contributions plus residuals; use quant-platform APIs.
acceptance.zh: 滞后暴露、可识别市场／行业回归与账户区间能核对贡献及残差；复用quant-platform接口。

nextAction.en: Admit the base model without turnover and the extended model with turnover.
nextAction.zh: 分别纳入不含换手与含换手的两套模型。

gap.en: Complete aligned exposure, industry and account intervals are not admitted.
gap.zh: 完整对齐的暴露、行业及账户区间尚未获准。

title.zh: 验证协方差与特质风险预测

acceptance.en: Estimate only from past data; test rolling forecast/realized risk, coverage and stress calibration.
acceptance.zh: 仅用过去数据估计，检验滚动预测／实现风险、覆盖及压力校准。

nextAction.en: Follow reconciled attribution with a separate forecast-validation experiment.
nextAction.zh: 归因核对后，另立预测验证实验。

gap.en: An exposure diagnostic or explanatory regression is not a validated risk forecast.
gap.zh: 暴露诊断或解释性回归不是经验证的风险预测。

title.zh: 检验低换手的增量信息

acceptance.en: Common support/date comparisons separate low volatility, activity, illiquidity and high-turnover avoidance; retain raw controls.
acceptance.zh: 共同支持／日期比较低波动、活跃度、非流动性及避开高换手的作用，保留原始控制。

nextAction.en: Pair the three-arm accounts with ablation and control-order sensitivities.
nextAction.zh: 配对三组账户，做剔除实验及控制顺序敏感性。

title.zh: 检验头部校准与单调性

acceptance.en: Predefine mutually exclusive rank bands and horizons; report paired uncertainty and overlapping-return treatment.
acceptance.zh: 预定义互斥排名区间及周期，报告配对不确定性和收益重叠处理。

nextAction.en: Join frozen formation ranks to admitted forward labels without dropping failed holdings.
nextAction.zh: 将冻结排名与获准未来标签对齐，不剔除失败持仓。

gap.en: The current exposure panel has no admitted forward-return labels.
gap.zh: 当前暴露面板没有获准的未来收益标签。

title.zh: 运行K与权重强度对照

acceptance.en: Compare a predeclared grid under matched risk/cost/eligibility and report stable regions, not a historical maximum.
acceptance.zh: 按预定网格在匹配风险、成本、资格下比较，报告稳定区域而非历史最优格。

nextAction.en: Extend existing exposure-only K comparisons after net-account admission.
nextAction.zh: 净账户获准后扩展现有仅暴露的K对照。

title.en: Separate holding buffers from signal smoothing
title.zh: 区分持有缓冲与信号平滑

acceptance.en: Same signals and dates; keep net returns, target changes, real turnover and residual risk separate.
acceptance.zh: 固定信号及日期，分开报告净收益、目标变化、实际换手与残差风险。

nextAction.en: Reuse historical buffer records as development evidence and construct paired ledger cases.
nextAction.zh: 以历史缓冲记录作开发证据，再构造配对账本案例。

title.en: Audit execution clocks and order evidence
title.zh: 审计执行时钟与订单证据

acceptance.en: Decisions, arrival quotes, trades, fees and unfilled inventory share verified units and clock semantics.
acceptance.zh: 决策、到达报价、成交、费用、未成交库存具有已验证的单位及时钟语义。

nextAction.en: Extend the two-date fitness review without claiming universal coverage.
nextAction.zh: 扩展两日期适用性检查，不宣称普遍覆盖。

title.en: Estimate matched cost scenarios and calibration
title.zh: 估计匹配成本情景与校准

acceptance.en: Separate fee/spread/impact/delay without double charging; scenario assumptions stay distinct from actual calibration.
acceptance.zh: 区分费用、价差、冲击、延迟并避免重复收费；情景假设与真实校准分开。

nextAction.en: Start with matched account scenarios; fit impact only if matched execution evidence is admitted.
nextAction.zh: 先做配对账户情景，匹配执行证据获准后才拟合冲击。

gap.en: Existing quote/account scenarios do not establish broker-calibrated costs.
gap.zh: 现有报价／账户情景不足以确立经券商执行校准的成本。

title.zh: 预定义压力事件与对照

acceptance.en: Fix market/size drawdown event rules before outcomes and retain normal controls; distinguish low-ADV months.
acceptance.zh: 在查看结果前固定市场／规模回撤事件规则，保留正常对照，并与低ADV月份区分。

nextAction.en: Review and freeze the draft only after the required input, account and clock evidence is admitted; do not relabel history as prospective.
nextAction.zh: 必需输入、账户及时钟证据获准后再审查冻结草案，不将历史重标为前瞻。

title.zh: 重放固定持仓的压力退出

acceptance.en: Freeze pre-event holdings; retain suspensions, missing observations, unsold inventory and cash through the horizon.
acceptance.zh: 冻结事件前持仓，在整个期限保留停牌、缺失、未售库存及现金。

nextAction.en: Run admission checks on pre-event targets, minute data and inventory before exit simulation.
nextAction.zh: 先检查事件前目标、分钟数据及库存是否获准，再模拟退出。

gap.en: Pre-event qualified holdings and aligned executable observations need admission.
gap.zh: 事件前合格持仓及对齐的可执行观测仍需获准。

title.en: Map capital, participation and exit capacity
title.zh: 绘制资金、参与率与退出容量

acceptance.en: Report net return, cost, unfilled inventory and exit time by capital/participation/horizon; do not equate ADV with capacity.
acceptance.zh: 按资金、参与率、期限报告净收益、成本、未成交库存和退出时间，不把ADV当容量。

nextAction.en: Use the same cost and stress-exit source revisions across the grid.
nextAction.zh: 整个网格使用相同成本和压力退出来源版本。

gap.en: Capacity depends on admitted execution and stress evidence.
gap.zh: 容量结论依赖获准的执行与压力证据。

title.zh: 审计历史财务覆盖

acceptance.en: Announcement-dated versions and loss/negative-equity/missing-report rules cover the intended microcap universe.
acceptance.zh: 公告时点版本及亏损、负净资产、缺报告规则覆盖目标微盘股票池。

nextAction.en: Measure coverage by date and size; retain the restricted post-2020 quality sample separately.
nextAction.zh: 按日期和规模测量覆盖，将2020年后受限质量样本分开保留。

gap.en: Existing quality diagnostics mainly cover post-2020 top-800 stocks.
gap.zh: 现有质量诊断主要覆盖2020年以后前800只股票。

title.zh: 运行市场特征剔除实验

acceptance.en: Size, turnover, volatility, reversal/momentum improve matched predictive or net portfolio outcomes with uncertainty reported.
acceptance.zh: 规模、换手、波动、反转／动量在配对预测或净组合结果中有增量，并报告不确定性。

nextAction.en: Evaluate a small fixed family set before expanding the library.
nextAction.zh: 扩展因子库前先评价少量固定因子组。

gap.en: The net-account and forward-label contracts must be satisfied first.
gap.zh: 先满足净账户与未来标签契约。

title.zh: 增量检验质量与估值

acceptance.en: Use matched PIT coverage; separate composite quality from components and do not duplicate leverage.
acceptance.zh: 使用匹配的时点覆盖，区分复合质量与子项，不重复计入杠杆。

nextAction.en: Add financial families only after coverage and baseline ablation admission.
nextAction.zh: 覆盖及基线剔除实验获准后再加入财务因子组。

gap.en: Financial coverage cannot be inferred from the historical 19-factor snapshot.
gap.zh: 不能从历史19因子快照推断财务覆盖。

title.zh: 起草统一的前瞻协议

acceptance.en: Name the protocol, freeze date, models, support, allocation, costs, endpoints and amendment policy; reconcile the prior 12/24-period rules.
acceptance.zh: 明确协议名、冻结日、模型、支持集、配置、成本、终点及修订政策，核对历史12／24期规则。

nextAction.en: Review and freeze the draft only after the required input, account and clock evidence is admitted; do not relabel history as prospective.
nextAction.zh: 必需输入、账户及时钟证据获准后再审查冻结草案，不将历史重标为前瞻。

title.en: Specify paired inference and search accounting
title.zh: 规定配对推断与试验登记

acceptance.en: Record every tried specification, overlapping horizons, block/HAC choice and multiplicity; no best-cell selection.
acceptance.zh: 记录全部尝试、重叠周期、分块／HAC选择和多重比较，不挑最优格。

nextAction.en: Apply the written specification only after the data and ledger admission gates pass.
nextAction.zh: 数据及账本门槛通过后，再按已写规范实施。

title.zh: 维护经过依赖检查的任务登记

acceptance.en: Every task has an ID, owner, priority, status, acceptance, dependency and next action; completed items link earned evidence.
acceptance.zh: 每项有编号、归属、优先级、状态、验收、依赖、下一步；完成项关联已有证据。

nextAction.en: Update status only through reviewed evidence changes.
nextAction.zh: 只随经审查的证据变化更新状态。

title.en: Publish and maintain the evidence map
title.zh: 发布并持续维护证据地图

acceptance.en: The bilingual site exposes priorities, current evidence, unmet gates and the next useful action with source identity.
acceptance.zh: 双语网站展示优先级、当前证据、未满足门槛及下一步，并保留来源身份。

nextAction.en: Publish the current source-pinned snapshot; refresh when actual research gates change.
nextAction.zh: 发布当前固定来源快照，实际研究门槛变化后再更新。
